notes.title: Harvested Chapters 4 And 5, LEAVING EARLY ACCESS, And What's Next
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35031818/96ad6532ca153887744b821e5ecf600f6a9734c6.png[/img]

We've got an exciting few months ahead of us!  We are excited to announce Harvested will be leaving Early Access in March 2021!

December 2020: Story Chapter 4 releases, bringing 3 new missions to Harvested

March 2021: Story Chapter 5 releases, bringing 3 new missions and signaling the end of Early Access for Harvested!

Summer 2021: We have a new game in development and we can't wait to start talking about it!

If you wonder what's next for Harvested, that's up to YOU!  We have ideas we'd love to continue to add to Harvested, and of course we'd love to release more maps!  We've been working on this game for nearly 8 years and, while we're excited to complete it, we're having a hard time letting go!

When the game is released, let us know what you want!  We will develop content as long as there is interest in this game.

Follow our page for the latest Harvested updates!

notes.title: RTS-Top Down Shooter Hybrid "Harvested" Is Now In Early Access!
notes.notes:
Vashta Entertainment's largest project to date, Harvested, has now entered early access!

Harvested has all the fun you'd expect from a strategy game - resource management, base building, and epic combat.

Additionally, Harvested lets you play as a soldier on the field.

A carefully-designed and meticulously-tested control scheme gives you all the power of a real time strategy game and a top-down shooter. There is no need to switch modes - every action is at your fingertips all the time.

Harvested defies he status-quo of bland procedural generation with hand-crafted maps that cater to specific strategies and conceal rewarding secrets.

Check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/893420/Harvested/]here[/url]!

notes.title: Builds For Mac And Linux Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We're happy to announce that Trenches of War is now available on Mac and Linux!  As always, PLEASE reach out to us with your bug reports, comments, concerns, feature requests... We love to hear from you!  Have fun in the trenches!

- Bret Black & Shane Draper
Vashta Entertainment

notes.title: Trenches of War Released!
notes.notes:
FINALLY! Trenches of War is now available on Steam!  We have decided to iron out the bugs in Windows before shipping the other operating systems. Mac and Linux will be released in the coming weeks.

We hope you like the new light engine.  We love the look of light shining out of the barracks' windows - especially in the snow.

Thank you for your patience.  We're sorry this took so much longer than we expected.  We ran into many issues with the multiplayer and unfortunately some of them are yet to be resolved.  We ultimately decided we'd rather get the game out there without multiplayer than delay its release any longer.  We will continue to work towards resolving these issues in the coming months and hope Multiplayer will be available soon.

Thank you again for your support.  As life-long gamers we've dreamed of having a game released on Steam and you made it happen.  As always, we love to hear your feedback and feel free to contact us with any suggestions or concerns.

Enjoy the trenches!

Best,
Bret Black and Shane Draper
Vashta Entertainment
